key_insight: OmniTongue exposes substantial gaps in multimodal AI’s ability to recognize fine-grained tongue features used in Traditional Chinese Medicine.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark supports research on automated TCM tongue assessment but does not establish clinical diagnostic validity or readiness.
method: Constructed a visual question-answering benchmark from expert-validated tongue images.
Covered 16 clinical dimensions and 66 fine-grained labels.
Included region-specific annotations and evaluated existing multimodal models.
evidence_signal: Across 1,351 images and 21,616 instruction pairs, evaluations found universally poor Macro-F1 scores and no domain advantage for medical-specific models.
watch_item: Poor benchmark performance limits deployment readiness, and public release of the code and dataset was still pending.
paper_title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
